issue.positionEn: Follow how materials, recordings and public spaces are made available for another use.
issue.introEn:
Re-dyed clothes, rearranged live recordings, a temporary exhibition on a road, and supports that keep a historic dress standing: this work changes how objects continue to appear. Starting with a Zurich light exhibition, today’s issue moves through New York, Doha, Tokyo, London, Paris and Hong Kong, then returns to two music releases.

Some projects have just opened; others have already ended. Each article keeps the dates explicit, separating current opportunities to visit from materials and processes that remain worth examining.
issue.closingEn: Preservation and renewal require different kinds of work. Wearing, supporting, playing and sharing offer another occasion for these works to change.

sabine-marcelis-light-and-color-2026.altZh: 粉色与蓝灰透明叠层构成的《Light and Color》官方海报。
sabine-marcelis-light-and-color-2026.altEn: Official Light and Color poster with pink and blue-grey translucent layers.
sabine-marcelis-light-and-color-2026.captionEn: Official Light and Color exhibition poster with translucent pink and blue-grey layers; not a photograph of the galleries.
sabine-marcelis-light-and-color-2026.summaryEn: Familiar lamps become spaces to enter, while material tests reveal how their light is made.

our-legacy-nike-sport-shop-nyc-2026.altZh: 戴红色角状发箍的人物抬手遮住一侧眼睛，穿着蓝灰色上衣。
our-legacy-nike-sport-shop-nyc-2026.altEn: Campaign portrait of a person wearing a red horn-shaped headband and a blue-grey top, with one hand raised across an eye.
our-legacy-nike-sport-shop-nyc-2026.captionEn: Sport Shop NYC by Our Legacy Work Shop and Nike. Photo: Peter Sutherland. The activation ended on November 1, 2026.
our-legacy-nike-sport-shop-nyc-2026.summaryEn: The completed Procell pop-up documents reworked Nike deadstock, distinct from the spring 2027 running collection.

makaya-mccraven-off-the-record-digital-2.altZh: 深褐底色、白色标题与黑白演出照片构成的《Off the Record》官方封面。
makaya-mccraven-off-the-record-digital-2.altEn: Official Off the Record cover, with white lettering and a black-and-white performance photograph on a dark brown ground.
makaya-mccraven-off-the-record-digital-2.captionEn: Official Off the Record release artwork. The digital edition does not indicate newly recorded 2026 performances.
makaya-mccraven-off-the-record-digital-2.summaryEn: A digital entry into four EPs assembled from earlier live recordings.

designart-tokyo-2026-kkline.altZh: 黑白KK高架道路资料图，上面为蓝色AUTOBAHN与DESIGNART字样。
designart-tokyo-2026-kkline.altEn: Black-and-white aerial view of the KK elevated road with blue AUTOBAHN and DESIGNART lettering.
designart-tokyo-2026-kkline.captionEn: KK Line venue reference image on the official DESIGNART project page. The page does not date this photograph; it is not identified as a current installation view.
designart-tokyo-2026-kkline.summaryEn: The temporary KK Line venue closes November3, before the wider festival. Reused road elements and hands-on design offer a focused route.

doha-designed-to-last-maison-artc-2026.altZh: 灰白背景中的粉红立体衣物与黑色人台剪影。
doha-designed-to-last-maison-artc-2026.altEn: Pink sculptural garment and a dark mannequin silhouette against a pale grey ground.
doha-designed-to-last-maison-artc-2026.captionEn: Official Designed to Last event visual showing a sculptural red garment detail; not an installation photograph.
doha-designed-to-last-maison-artc-2026.summaryEn: Thirteen unique looks, photography and a 3 November discussion ask what makes clothes worth keeping.

mariko-mori-all-that-shines.altZh: 银色《Wave UFO》舱体与台阶，入口有蓝光；为2003年布雷根茨美术馆资料图。
mariko-mori-all-that-shines.altEn: The silver Wave UFO pod and access steps, with blue light at the entrance; archive installation image from Bregenz in 2003.
mariko-mori-all-that-shines.captionEn: Mariko Mori, Wave UFO (1999–2002), installed at Kunsthaus Bregenz, Austria, in 2003. This is an archive image, not the current Tokyo installation. Photo: Richard Learoyd.
mariko-mori-all-that-shines.summaryEn: A new retrospective follows Mori’s changing tools, with Wave UFO’s visitor procedure and the limits of technical claims kept visible.

palace-nike-manor-place-fc-first-anniver.altZh: 穿蓝绿色外套与黑色帽子的模特站在脚手架下。
palace-nike-manor-place-fc-first-anniver.altEn: A model in a teal jacket and black beanie beneath scaffolding.
palace-nike-manor-place-fc-first-anniver.captionEn: Official styling photograph for the anniversary collection, not a football match at the venue.
palace-nike-manor-place-fc-first-anniver.summaryEn: The kit carries the crest; the venue has another programme to run.

mad-look-40-years-fashion-museum-2026.altZh: 木质人台穿着淡粉色长裙，裙身点缀花瓣和圆片状装饰。
mad-look-40-years-fashion-museum-2026.altEn: A pale pink full-length dress on an articulated wooden mannequin, with petal and circular appliqués.
mad-look-40-years-fashion-museum-2026.captionEn: Madeleine Vionnet, 1938, shown in the 2009 exhibition Madeleine Vionnet. Collection photograph supplied on the museum’s current exhibition page, not an installation view of the current galleries. © Les Arts Décoratifs / Jean Tholance
mad-look-40-years-fashion-museum-2026.summaryEn: A museum preserves more than a silhouette: patterns, supports and patient work keep clothes visible.

ellen-pau-luminosity-mplus-2026.altZh: 黑底上的表演者与发亮的双手，周围叠着模糊的黑白光迹。
ellen-pau-luminosity-mplus-2026.altEn: A performer and brightly lit hands emerge amid overlapping monochrome light trails against black.
ellen-pau-luminosity-mplus-2026.captionEn: Ellen Pau, Luminosity (2026), video still, courtesy of the artist. Source: PF25 official exhibition page. This is not an installation view of the current M+ presentation.
ellen-pau-luminosity-mplus-2026.summaryEn: A free Grand Stair presentation of Luminosity opened on October 30, distinct from The Shape of Light (2022) and its facade setting.

smashing-pumpkins-lull-35th-anniversary-.altZh: 《Lull》封面，紫色乐队名与绿色波线、彩色花纹围绕浅色纸面。
smashing-pumpkins-lull-35th-anniversary-.altEn: Lull cover with purple band lettering, green wavy lines and coloured floral patterns on pale paper.
smashing-pumpkins-lull-35th-anniversary-.captionEn: Cover artwork displayed by the official Lull 35th-anniversary listening and purchasing link. The individual cover designer was not verified in the current official record.
smashing-pumpkins-lull-35th-anniversary-.summaryEn: An early four-song sequence returns, with its recording history kept in view.
